description: We are a creative and curious team passionate about space exploration, storytelling and innovation. Through "Abandoned but Not Forgotten", we aim to bring forgotten space missions to life through creativity and science. We welcome passionate members skilled in writing, poetry, rap, music, graphic design, video editing, research, astronomy and communication. We value fresh ideas, teamwork and imagination. No coding expertise required—just curiosity and creativity!
summary:
ECHOES BEYOND EARTH: The Last Letters of Forgotten Explorers

Project Summary

ECHOES BEYOND EARTH is a creative educational project inspired by NASA's challenge Abandoned but Not Forgotten. It aims to bring the stories of past space missions back to life and help people remember the robotic explorers that contributed to our understanding of space.

Our project focuses on three historic missions: Opportunity and Spirit, which explored Mars, and Surveyor 3, which explored the Moon. Although these missions have ended, their discoveries and contributions remain important.

We present their journeys through a digital storybook, illustrated storytelling, mission timelines, real NASA images, audio narration and original poetry or rap. The project uses creative, imagined letters from the explorers to make their journeys more engaging and emotional. These letters are clearly identified as fictional storytelling, while all scientific information and mission achievements are based on verified facts.

The main goal is to make space exploration interesting and understandable, especially for students and young audiences. By combining science with storytelling, we hope to encourage curiosity, improve awareness of historic space missions and inspire the next generation of explorers.

Our message is simple: Even when a mission ends, its discoveries and legacy continue to inspire us.
